FollowUpQuestions: for requirement a5894828fc7c: ask "Did you personally hold the go-live decision for each adviser cohort?" etc.

optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Wealth Services Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced project manager with a focus on reporting-engine migration for wealth services platforms, overseeing project planning, risk management, steering committee coordination, and cohort readiness.
experienceHighlights: Maintained the project plan, risk log, and adviser-cohort schedule for the reporting-engine migration in the project tool, re-planning the schedule when the data-migration phase slipped by three weeks.
Prepared the steering committee pack each month and presented the schedule and risk sections; the programme director chaired the committee and put the cohort go-live decisions to it.

Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team through the readiness checklist; each cohort's go-live was approved by the steering committee on the programme director's recommendation.
Wrote the go-live note for each of the four adviser cohorts, listing open defects, reporting limitations during the parallel run and the hand-over items for adviser support.

Responsibilities included plan and risk-log maintenance, steering pack preparation, readiness coordination and go-live notes for the migration project over about eighteen months, working to the programme director.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: the cohort schedule export with the readiness checklist for cohort three and the steering committee pack for one month, with the project tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.
